instruction: Look at guih20_fixture_jig_seed.dxf in LibreCAD. For this task, launch LibreCAD from `/usr/bin/librecad` before opening `guih20_fixture_jig_seed.dxf`. Complete the hard composite fixture jig. Draw FIXTURE rectangle (0,0)-(420,260), inner CUT rectangle (35,35)-(385,225), 15 HOLE circles radius 3 at x=70,140,210,280,350 crossed with y=70,130,190, four HOLE locator circles radius 8 at (105,100), (315,100), (105,160), and (315,160), DATUM_TARGET circles radius 6 at (60,35), (360,35), and (60,225), horizontal SLOTs 52 x 10 centered at (210,70), (210,190), (70,130), and (350,130), CENTER axes (0,130)-(420,130) and (210,0)-(210,260), and notes COMPOSITE FIXTURE JIG FJ-20, 15X Ø6 GRID, 4X Ø16 LOCATORS, DATUM A B C, and ALL DIMENSIONS MM. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih20_fixture_jig_completed.dxf.
